newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Supply of Bulgaria interbank deposits tops demand.
newsitem.headline: Supply of Bulgaria interbank deposits tops demand.

text.p: Supply of Bulgarian interbank deposits topped demand on Thursday as the spot week lev funds rate fell, dealers said.
"Banks sought small amounts of funds for periods of up to three days which prevented a fall in short-term interbank rates," said a dealer.
A cut in the main interest rate due to become effective on Monday did not have any impact on the depo rates.
However, the interbank rates were likely to fall by 2.0-4.0 points when the new main rate came into force, traders said.
The central bank cut its simple annual main rate to 6.96 percent from the current 9.76 percent, effective from July 14.
Overnight interbank depo rates stood at 4.0-4.5 percent annual, flat from Wednesday.
Spot week rates fell to 5.0-5.5 percent annually from 6.0-6.5 percent, traders said.
